verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਿਖ ਸਦਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh sun gursikh sikh sadhaiaa|

en.bdb: Having listened to the teaching of Guru,
The Sikh of Guru has called other Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਉ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh sun kar bhaau ma(n)n vasaiaa|

en.bdb: Adopting the teachings of the Guru,
The Sikh has recited the same to others.
The Sikhs of the Guru have liked the Sikhs and thus a Sikh has met the Sikhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸੋਲਹ ਸਾਰ ਜੁਗ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੧੮॥
verses.translit_en: chaupaR soleh saar jug jin aaiaa ||18||

en.bdb: The pair of the Guru and the disciple has conquered the world-game of oblong dice.
